India's fuel price rise lower than global average, says minister

Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri stated on Sunday that petrol and diesel prices in India have increased by only 7% over a four-year period. He contrasted this with a global rise of 50-70% in fuel prices during the same timeframe, attributing India's comparatively lower increase to three reductions in central excise duty.
